column1: # The swords of her looks: <example><tier>. 1 the Highlands, 2 Moonlit, 3 Amirani's fire. (S11 was the first, a test.)

column2: A Georgian khmali sword: straight double-edged steel blade with two parallel fullers, short cross-shaped crossguard with flared ends, grip wrapped in dark brown leather with silver wire, round silver pommel engraved with a Georgian cross. One one-handed sword only, no scabbard, no stand, full length.

An ornate royal Georgian sabre: curved damascus steel blade with gold inlaid ornaments near the hilt, gilded hilt with an eagle-head pommel and a small gold crossguard set with red garnets, red leather grip bound with gold wire. One one-handed sword only, no scabbard, no stand, full length.

An elegant silver sabre with a crescent-moon curved blade of polished mirror steel, crossguard shaped like a thin crescent moon, white leather grip, silver pommel holding a pale moonstone. One one-handed sword only, no scabbard, no stand, full length.

A fantasy longsword of pale blue moonsteel: slender straight blade engraved with the phases of the moon along its fuller, silver crossguard shaped like two small swept feathers, dark blue leather grip, pommel holding a pale blue gem. One one-handed sword only, no scabbard, no stand, full length.

A fantasy sword with a translucent pale cyan crystal blade with tiny glowing stars inside it, silver filigree crossguard shaped like an eight-pointed star, white grip bound with silver, star-shaped silver pommel. One one-handed sword only, no scabbard, no stand, full length.

An ancient Colchian bronze sword: leaf-shaped double-edged bronze blade with a raised midrib, simple bronze crossguard, grip wrapped in red-brown leather, bronze disc pommel. One one-handed sword only, no scabbard, no stand, full length.

A fantasy sword of blackened forged steel with glowing orange ember cracks and runes along the blade, dark iron crossguard with short spikes, red leather grip, iron pommel with an amber stone. One one-handed sword only, no scabbard, no stand, full length.

A fantasy flamberge sword with a wavy flame-shaped blade of red-gold metal glowing like fire, gold crossguard shaped like spread phoenix wings, crimson grip bound with gold, ruby pommel. One one-handed sword only, no scabbard, no stand, full length.
